Your warranty coverage depends on when you purchased your suitcase. For suitcases bought on or after April 14, 2026, our LifetimeCare™ Coverage offers repair support for the life of your suitcase, with complimentary repairs for the first five years and up to one replacement if a repair isn't possible.
